newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-NSW END LOSING RUN AGAINST OTAGO.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NSW END LOSING RUN AGAINST OTAGO.

text.p: New South Wales rebounded from a succession of embarrassing losses in the Super 12 rugby series with a 27-16 victory over Otago at Carisbrook on Friday.
New South Wales broke a three-match losing streak, including a humiliating 56-9 defeat by Australian Capital Territory, scoring three tries to one.
Jason Madz, Alistair Murdoch and Michael Brial scored tries for New South Wales, while full-back Matthew Burke landed three conversions and two penalties for a personal tally of 12 points.
Lio Falaniko scored Otago's only try. Both sides are out of the running for the semifinals later this month.
